application_mode: CSC (Common Services Centre) Assisted Registration with Biometric Auth

application_steps.action: Artisan visits nearest CSC. Enters Aadhaar & mobile number. Completes biometric fingerprint scan.
Select trade from 18 traditional professions. Enter family details and address.
Enter bank account details for stipend & ₹15,000 tool kit incentive. Choose whether loan is requested (Tranche 1: ₹1 Lakh @ 5%).

workflow: Tier 1: Gram Panchayat Head / Ward Member verification of trade practice
Tier 2: District Implementation Committee (headed by Collector / MSME DFO)
Tier 3: National Steering Committee approval -> PM Vishwakarma Digital Certificate & ID Card issued

benefits_disbursement.toolkit: ₹15,000 e-voucher via digital payment / UPI for modern tools
benefits_disbursement.loan: Up to ₹3,00,000 collateral-free loan at 5% interest (Subsidized by GoI up to 8%)
